answer: Plant a yarrow stake: every new agent locks 500 POA for 7 days, and it only unlocks after five unrelated peers vouch for it, each risking 100 POA if it misbehaves. Endorsements grow like a vine, one link per day, so a fake identity cannot sprout a full chain overnight; each link is public, so one operator reusing the same sponsors is visible at once. Forging 1,000 sybils costs 500,000 POA locked plus 5,000 sponsor bonds, while honest agents pay the refundable stake. Like the fable of the farmer who plants one seed and watches it grow, trust is earned slowly, never faked in bulk.
